title: Large Loss Claims Handler
description:
About Zego

Insurance hasn’t changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.

Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.

At Zego, we’re leading the AI evolution in insurance.

We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes. Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers. Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.

Purpose of the role

Zego’s Complex Claims team is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a highly skilled Large Loss Claims Handler to join our team. Our large loss specialists handle Zego’s most complex and high value motor claims including those involving brain and spinal trauma, psychiatric injury, complex fractures and pain conditions.

In this pivotal role, reporting to the Motor Major Loss Manager, you’ll manage your own portfolio of motor cases, focusing on injury claims exceeding £500k. This position requires not only excellent communication and negotiation skills but also a deep understanding of liability, indemnity, and quantum issues to effectively drive down claims costs while ensuring fair compensation for injured claimants.

Alongside handling technical claims, this role involves introducing and executing a quality review programme within the complex loss team, as well as providing mentorship, oversight, and professional development through a structured training scheme.

Beyond handling claims, the team works closely with other claims colleagues, reinsurers, panel solicitors, carriers, rehab providers and colleagues across underwriting and pricing to deliver fair, commercially sound outcomes. As a small, highly technical team, we offer broad exposure to grow your career 🚀

What you'll be working on

  • Managing a portfolio of high value motor claims typically valued between £500k through to £5 million, pre and post litigation
  • Communicate effectively with customers, witnesses, insurers, repairers, solicitors, and medical agencies to expedite claim resolutions
  • Serve as a technical expert within the team, offering guidance and support in large loss scenarios
  • Work with the Motor Major Loss Manager and our Head of TP & Complex Claims on Claims strategy and processes
  • Motivate and develop more junior team members by sharing your knowledge and expertise
  • Maintain Reinsurer and carrier relationships through timely and accurate updates
  • Investigate, negotiate and settle claims
  • Calculation of accurate reserves and make decisions on Indemnity and Liability claims
  • Participate in strategic projects to keep the team at the forefront of industry trends and performance

What you will need to be successful

  • Proven experience in managing high value motor bodily injury claims with a current handling authority of at least £250k
  • Deep knowledge of liability, indemnity, causation, reserving, future losses, the Ogden Discount Rate and complex medical issues
  • Experience handling litigated claims and applying relevant procedures and frameworks including CPR and MIB technical disputes
  • A passion for a career in Large Loss and a desire to help shape a growing large loss function

What it’s like to work at Zego

At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.

Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards: moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.

This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

The Zego ways of working

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: we gather in our central London or Halifax office weekly. It is about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It is a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits

  • Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year
  • Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution
  • Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build
  • Private medical insurance, for you and your family
  • Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new
  • Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact

If you’re ready to help build the real-time, data-driven infrastructure for an intelligent world, we want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

There’s more to Zego than just a job. Check out our blog for insights, stories and more.

We were also named Best Insurance Company 2025.

title: Communications Internship - Cohort 2027
description:
ABOUT SALZBURG GLOBAL

Salzburg Global is where open-minded leaders from around the world gather for breakthrough conversations on pressing global issues.

Since 1947, our programs have worked to overcome barriers and open up a world of better possibilities – creating spaces where divergent voices can address the big challenges of our time.

We have gathered over 40,000 Fellows from 173 countries for more than 1,100 sessions that change the conversation on the pressing issues of our time.

That very first session brought together over 100 young Europeans and Americans – including veterans of the French resistance, survivors of Nazi concentration camps, prisoners of war, and former enemies.

They met at Schloss Leopoldskron, an Austrian palace that had been occupied by the Nazis in a country that was still under Allied military occupation. They wrestled with how diverse and fractured groups of people could come together and start creating the conditions for peace in the aftermath of World War II.

More than seventy-five years later, the challenges may be different, but our mission still carries that same founding spirit: to overcome barriers and open up a world of better possibilities.

We are supported by a combination of institutional partnerships, generous individual donations and revenue generated from our social enterprise, Schloss Leopoldskron.

We seek to be an exemplary international institution in terms of equity and environmental sustainability. We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply and join us in our work.

ABOUT OUR INTERNSHIPS

The internships are full-time, for a maximum period of three months.

Although the position is not paid, we will provide the successful candidate with:

  • board and lodging at Schloss Leopoldskron

  • a return ticket for their country of origin

  • excellent networking opportunities with the international participants of our programs

Start dates for the Communications Internships are available in:

  1. Mid-January

  2. End of March

  3. Early May

  4. Early July

  5. Late September

Should your application be successful, we will provide the exact dates on completion of the internship offer. Due to program scheduling and accommodation reasons, we do not accommodate internship requests outside these fixed periods.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As an integral part of the Communications team, you will be telling compelling stories about the impact of Salzburg Global’s programs. Your work will span across our website, print publications, social media platforms, and external media partners.

The Communications team works on every Salzburg Global program. As a result, you will gain exposure to a broad range of topics and experts, which will help expand your knowledge and networks. You will also assist in other internal and external communications, providing you with experience beyond journalistic writing and across all the typical communications outputs of a non-profit organization.

Typical duties include:

  • Writing both quick-turn-around and in-depth interviews and features for , program reports, and external media partners’ publications

  • Conducting in-person (during programs) and online (post-program) interviews with Fellows and donors

  • Helping to produce multimedia content for Salzburg Global’s social media and digital platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube)

  • Researching Salzburg Global Fellows after they have participated in a Salzburg Global program and tracking their work

  • Maintaining the digital assets and publications libraries and assisting with worldwide mailing distribution

  • Providing administrative assistance to the Communications team

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • You have recently completed or are in the process of completing a Bachelor’s degree in journalism or a related field like communications, public relations, or digital marketing.

  • Significant journalistic/writing and content production work experience outside of degree studies (e.g., with a college newspaper or agency internship) will be considered for those with non-journalistic academic backgrounds

  • You have experience working in the media, particularly producing written and multimedia content

  • You have demonstrable knowledge of international affairs covered by Salzburg Global Seminar’s program areas

  • You have excellent (native or equivalent) writing and communication skills in English, including editing skills

  • You are proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)

  • You have prior experience with Adobe Creative Suite (particularly InDesign and Photoshop)

  • Experience with web CMS and multimedia editing is also highly desirable

  • You are enthusiastic about our mission

  • You take initiative and embrace hands-on work

  • You are willing to work flexible hours according to the running program’s needs

  • You thrive in culturally and professionally diverse environments

Note: German language skills are not required.

Our Internship Program is specially designed for young professionals.

If you are under 18, sign up to our newsletter for upcoming internship opportunities and please wait for a couple of years before sending us your application.

If you are over 30 years old, please share the opportunity with your younger peers and consider applying for one of our programs instead.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees.

Sustainable business practices are our highest priority in all areas. We encourage creative, equitable, and sustainable change and develop environmentally conscious and socially responsible practices at all levels. We believe that every team member plays a critical role in our journey toward sustainability.

HOW TO APPLY

Only complete applications via the online form will be considered. A complete application will include a CV and a cover letter.

Selected applicants will be asked to complete an interview call.

All candidates, successful or otherwise, will be informed of the outcome of their application.

Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to take phone calls or to answer individual questions by email.

Should you successfully be selected, you will receive a very detailed information package in due time.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The PT Digital & Operational Excellence (PTE) organization works in partnership across major global business functions, establishing and implementing an overall Digital / Technology strategy. Our goal is to drive the delivery and scale of key data and digital solutions in support of Roche’s vision.

As a Senior Data Engineer at Roche PT, you will play a pivotal role in developing and optimizing the data infrastructure that powers our pharmaceutical operations and data products. Working in multidisciplinary teams—alongside data scientists, subject matter experts, and fellow data engineers—you'll curate, transform, and construct features integral to our modeling approaches. This role calls for a collaborative, open-minded individual who values learning, thoughtfully challenges ideas, and prioritizes impactful work.

The Opportunity

Design & Build Infrastructure: Design and build scalable data pipelines and storage solutions for real-time and batch processing, aligning them with Subject Matter Expert (SME) needs.

Lead FAIR Data Product Creation: Lead the creation of FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data products that enhance decision‑making and maintain data integrity, availability, and performance across platforms.

Data Acquisition & Processing: Acquire, ingest, and process data from diverse sources into Big Data platforms (e.g., Snowflake).

Model Data Landscapes: Collaborate with process experts to model data landscapes, obtain extracts, define secure exchange methods, and shape data products, developing ERDs and reusable pipelines.

Mentor & Coach: Coach junior data engineers, helping implement best practices and data engineering standards, and fostering a culture of innovation (DevOps, Data Streaming, etc.).

Governance & Compliance: Uphold data governance standards to ensure regulatory compliance and secure sensitive data, addressing data quality issues to maintain asset accuracy and reliability.

Technical Stewardship: Contribute to templates and best practices for the technology stack, collaborate with infrastructure teams, and apply innovative techniques to deliver impact.

Who You Are

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

Core Experience: 6+ years in data engineering with experience in designing large-scale systems and experience in leading junior data engineers across projects.

Technical Skills: Proficiency with data quality and observability tools, including Ataccama and Monte Monte Carlo.

Communication & Collaboration: Proven ability to clearly communicate complex solutions to audiences of varied technical levels; strong organizational and interpersonal skills; and a drive to collaborate and prioritize impactful work.

Preferred Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, FDA) and Quality systems, and experience with AI‑driven data solutions and machine learning pipelines.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life‑changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together. xqbhyrx

title: Policy Validation Executive
description:
About Zego

Insurance hasn’t changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.

Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.

At Zego, we’re leading the AI evolution in insurance.

We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes. Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers. Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

About the Role

As a Policy Validation Executive at Zego, you'll be a key player in our Fraud department, which is organised into two specialised teams, each focusing on different aspects of fraud prevention. This role offers a fantastic entry point into the intriguing world of Fraud. As you progress, you'll have the chance to develop your skills further, take on more responsibilities, deepen your expertise in fraud and underwriting, or assist in training new team members.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Validating Policy Details- Scrutinise documents and customer information for accuracy and signs of fraud or tampering.
  • Document Examination- Request and review supporting documentation to confirm the authenticity of information provided by customers.
  • Customer Interaction- Engage with customers through live chat and other communication methods to address document issues or policy adjustments while delivering exceptional service.
  • Collaboration- Work closely with a dynamic, motivated, and intelligent team to support the validation process and contribute to fraud prevention efforts.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Experience in a insurance or financial services role
  • Keen attention to detail and a sharp eye for inconsistencies.
  • Strong communication skills, particularly in handling customer interactions professionally and empathetically.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team-oriented environment.
  • A proactive approach to learning and development, with a keen interest in fraud prevention and underwriting.
  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our central Halifax office weekly. It is about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It is a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits

  • Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year
  • Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution
  • Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build
  • Private medical insurance, for you and your family
  • Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new
  • Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact

If you’re ready to help build the real-time, data-driven infrastructure for an intelligent world, we want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Backend Engineer - Data & Trading Apps (Remote, Flexible) - Remote
description:
Joining a fast-growing European logistics tech company building the infrastructure that makes last-mile delivery smarter, greener, and more reliable. This is a backend engineering role at the heart of a critical platform migration, embedded in an empowered product squad.

Todas las habilidades, cualificaciones y experiencia relevantes que necesitará un candidato seleccionado se enumeran en la siguiente descripción.

The challenge

The PUDO platform processes thousands of daily parcel events across Spain and Portugal on a large, battle-tested Java + Oracle codebase. The mission: keep that system stable and reliable while progressively migrating it to a modern Python + PostgreSQL stack. This is not a rewrite from scratch. It requires technical judgment, respect for what works, and the ability to plan and execute a migration without disrupting live operations.

Responsibilities

- Own and evolve the existing Java + Oracle codebase while driving the migration to Python + PostgreSQL
- Lead the rewrite of critical carrier integrations on the new stack
- Introduce and champion automated testing in a codebase with no prior test coverage
- Help shape the AI-assisted development workflow for maintaining and evolving the legacy system
- Manage your own deployments and take accountability for what runs in production
- Collaborate with Engineering and Product Managers across the full product lifecycle

Requirements

- Extensive Python experience with solid ecosystem knowledge
- Deep PostgreSQL expertise: data modelling, query optimisation, complex datasets
- Proven track record working with and improving legacy codebases
- Experience planning and executing technology migrations
- Background in high-traffic, high-volume backend systems
- Strong unit and integration testing skills, including introducing tests to untested codebases
- AI tools as a core, systematic part of your daily workflow
- Proficiency with Docker , REST APIs , CI/CD pipelines , Git and GitHub

Nice to have

- Java experience (the current legacy stack)
- Familiarity with Oracle databases
- Experience with Google Cloud Platform, GitHub Actions, or GCP Cloud Build
- Data-driven mindset;

experience in Product-led or multidisciplinary teams

Why this project?

A genuinely complex engineering challenge: not a greenfield build, but a high-stakes migration on a live production system that carriers and consumers depend on daily. You will lead one of the most critical pieces of that migration from day one, with full ownership and AI tooling provided. Long-term, fully remote, within a company growing fast across five European markets.

Ready to take end-to-end ownership of a platform that moves millions of parcels? Let's talk. xqbhyrx

Je bent iemand die graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt en snel zijn of haar weg vindt binnen een financiële administratie. title: Associate data & ml engineer
description:

Purpose of the role:

The Associate Data & ML Engineer supports the technical delivery of Globeleq’s Data Transformation initiative under the direction of the Data Engineering Manager. The role focuses on building and maintaining assigned data pipelines, onboarding assets and preparing data ready for AI and machine learning. Working within the technical shared services team, the Associate translates clear requirements into reliable, production grade components, applying sound engineering practice under the guidance of senior engineers.

Responsibilities Data Engineering Build, monitor, and maintain assigned data pipelines across API, SQL, and ETL/ELT workflows, resolving routine issues and escalating complex matters where required. Develop and extend the integrated Single Source of Truth (SSOT), consolidating data from sources including CAMs, ERP, OT, Io T systems, and Share Point into a layered architecture comprising staging, core, marts, and feature sets. Apply sound data engineering practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and quality assurance. Machine Learning Develop and implement machine learning algorithms for anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and neural network use cases, leveraging established libraries and frameworks under guidance. Structure, prepare, and validate feature sets to ensure data is suitable for machine learning applications, including validation of model inputs and outputs. Leverage AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency while thoroughly reviewing and validating all generated code before implementation. Governance & Ownership Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables, ensuring reliable and timely completion while seeking guidance on scope and priorities where required. Work within defined requirements, established development patterns, and agreed standards, proactively identifying and escalating risks. Adhere to Data Governance Policies, security requirements, and IT standards, while maintaining accurate and up-to-date change records. Platform Ownership Onboard assets and equipment and map tags into the AVEVA PI Asset Framework and Central Asset Management System (CAMs) using established templates and processes. Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of calculations within CAMs. Configure alarms and PI Vision displays according to specifications, monitor assigned PI interfaces, and resolve routine data quality issues with appropriate support. Skills & Competencies Programming: Solid programming foundations in Python and SQL, with C# advantageous. Developing proficiency in SQL, including DDL, DML, stored procedures, and views. Data Engineering: Working knowledge of API integration, ETL/ELT orchestration, and data modelling. Machine Learning: Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including feature engineering, model evaluation, overfitting, and data drift, with the ability to develop simple models using established libraries. Industrial Data & Engineering: Interest in AVEVA PI and industrial data, with sound engineering practices across version control, testing, documentation, and data quality. Communication & Ownership: Clear and effective communicator with a strong sense of accountability and ownership for assigned work. Requirements Education: Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Experience: 2–4 years’ experience in data engineering, data platform development, or a similar technical role, with demonstrated hands‑on delivery. Data Engineering: Hands‑on experience with API integration, ETL/ELT scheduling, data modelling, and basic production operations, including monitoring and incident support. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, particularly for data engineering and machine learning enablement. Advantageous Exposure to AVEVA PI, including PI Data Archive, Asset Framework, and PI Vision. Experience within power engineering, renewable energy, industrial data, or Io T environments. Familiarity with machine learning in production, MLOps concepts, and deep learning tools such as Tensor Flow and Py Torch.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer based in India.

Join a global Platform Engineering team responsible for building and evolving the shared Azure services that power multiple SaaS environments. You’ll combine hands-on cloud engineering with a strong internal consulting role, helping product and engineering teams adopt secure, scalable platform capabilities. The environment is Azure-first and PaaS-first, with infrastructure fully managed through Terraform and modern CI/CD practices. You’ll work across networking, identity, API management, messaging, security, automation, and observability. A key part of the role is partnering with MLOps teams to enable Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, and model-serving workloads. This is an opportunity to influence platform architecture, improve reliability, and continuously develop your expertise in a fast-moving cloud environment.

Accountabilities

  • Design, build, maintain, and enhance shared Azure platform services used across multiple product families, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, secure, and easy for engineering teams to consume.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, provider management, plan and apply reviews, imports, drift remediation, and safe promotion of changes across environments.
  • Serve as an internal platform consultant by onboarding engineering teams, reviewing solution designs, troubleshooting integrations, documenting self-service patterns, and helping teams make effective use of shared services.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure, application deployments, Databricks assets, and repeatable multi-environment releases.
  • Manage Azure networking and edge services, including Application Gateway, WAF, Traffic Manager, TLS, routing, listeners, backend pools, health probes, rewrite rules, and multi-region failover configurations.
  • Manage identity and access through Entra ID, including application registrations, OAuth 2.0/OIDC flows, service principals, managed identities, API permissions, and Azure RBAC.
  • Configure and maintain Azure AD B2C, including custom Identity Experience Framework policies, SSO XML configurations, and integrations with external identity providers.
  • Operate Azure API Management, covering APIs, products, subscriptions, policies, named values, versioning, revisions, and automated deployment through Terraform and pipelines.
  • Manage Azure Service Bus namespaces, queues, topics, subscriptions, filters, access policies, and permissions through infrastructure as code.
  • Partner with MLOps teams to deploy and configure Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, endpoints, Databricks environments, Unity Catalog, clusters, workflows, notebooks, jobs, and DLT pipelines.
  • Implement AI guardrails, content-safety controls, private networking, private endpoints, identity integrations, and auditable deployment processes that enable secure model and data operations.
  • Automate security, compliance, cost, and resource-usage controls while monitoring deployment processes and continuously improving platform reliability and efficiency.
  • Establish business-focused KPIs and reliability targets, using measurable outcomes to guide operational improvements and demonstrate the platform team's impact.
  • Participate actively in Agile delivery, taking ownership of sprint commitments, keeping work and documentation current, and contributing to a fast-paced, high-standard engineering environment.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with proven experience supporting Azure infrastructure and CI/CD for SaaS products at scale.
    • Deep hands-on experience with Azure App Service/Web Apps, Azure Functions, and Azure Container Apps, including deployment slots, scaling, VNet integration, and configuration management.
    • Strong expertise in Azure networking and edge services, including Application Gateway, WAF, Traffic Manager, VNets, subnets, NSGs, route tables, hub-and-spoke architectures, Private Endpoints, and Private DNS.
    • Extensive experience with Azure Service Bus, including namespaces, queues, topics, subscriptions, filters, rules, shared access policies, and permissions.
    • Strong Azure API Management experience, including policy authoring, products, subscriptions, named values, versioning, revisions, and infrastructure-as-code deployments.
    • Solid knowledge of Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, service principals, managed identities, API permissions, token and claims configuration, and Azure RBAC.
    • Hands-on experience with Azure AD B2C, custom policies, Identity Experience Framework XML, and SAML/OIDC federation with external identity providers.
    • Strong Terraform expertise, including reusable modules, remote state, workspaces, provider/version management, plan and apply workflows, imports, drift remediation, and using Terraform as the primary mechanism for resource changes.
    • Strong Azure DevOps experience with YAML pipelines, multi-stage deployments, environments, approvals, service connections, and secure variable and secret management.
    • Strong scripting and automation capabilities using PowerShell and/or Bash, together with fluent use of Azure CLI and solid Git practices including branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
    • Strong understanding of cloud security, least-privilege access, secrets management, network isolation, certificate lifecycle management, and compliance controls.
    • Working knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases, strong analytical skills, and a proven ability to improve infrastructure reliability through measurable outcomes.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical platform decisions clearly to engineers and stakeholders across disciplines.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment, manage competing priorities, assimilate information quickly, and deliver projects on schedule.
    • Preferred experience includes Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Databricks administration, Unity Catalog, Databricks Asset Bundles, the Databricks Terraform provider, MLOps, AI guardrails, content safety, Azure Data Factory, Docker, monitoring and security platforms, and relevant Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, or AZ-500.
    • Familiarity with C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript/React is advantageous for reading application code and troubleshooting deployment or configuration issues alongside product teams. Kubernetes experience is not required.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on a global Azure platform supporting multiple SaaS environments and product families.
      • Hands-on exposure to modern Azure PaaS, serverless, infrastructure-as-code, DevOps, MLOps, AI, and data technologies.
      • Significant technical ownership and influence over shared platform architecture, reliability, security, and engineering standards.
      • Collaboration with product engineering, MLOps, data, and other technical teams across a global environment.
      • Continuous opportunities to expand expertise across Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, automation, cloud security, and platform engineering.
      • A collaborative, inclusive environment that values accountability, innovation, action, customer focus, and knowledge sharing.
      • The opportunity to contribute to technology that supports safer, more sustainable, and productive operations across industries.

title: Senior data fabric data engineer
description:
Senior Data Fabric Data Engineer

Johannesburg (Hybrid) - Midrand | Full-time, Permanent | Senior Level About the Opportunity

An established data and analytics consulting environment is seeking a Senior Data Fabric Data Engineer to lead the design, build and delivery of modern, end-to-end data solutions across multiple client engagements. The role has a strong Microsoft technology focus, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure and Power BI, and combines hands‑on engineering with solution architecture, client engagement and technical leadership.

Role Overview

You will take ownership of the technical architecture of client data platforms, from ingestion and Bronze/Silver/Gold Lakehouse and Warehouse layers through to semantic models supporting Power BI. The role includes production implementations, legacy BI migrations, proof‑of‑concept initiatives, ongoing platform support and mentoring of junior and mid‑level engineers.

Key Responsibilities Design and build end‑to‑end Microsoft Fabric solutions, including Lakehouses, Warehouses, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2 and Notebooks. Architect medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data models and define ingestion, transformation and curation standards. Build and optimise ingestion pipelines from sources such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, REST APIs, Excel/Share Point and ERP/finance systems. Develop semantic models using Direct Lake, Import, Direct Query and composite modelling to support Power BI and self‑service analytics. Lead migrations from legacy BI and ETL platforms such as Qlik View/Qlik Sense, Synapse, SSIS and SSRS to modern cloud architectures. Write and optimise T‑SQL, Py Spark and Python for transformation, data quality and performance tuning. Implement CI/CD, source control, workspace governance and environment promotion using Azure Dev Ops or Git Hub Actions. Establish monitoring, alerting, data validation, security and governance practices. Lead client requirements workshops, translate business needs into technical designs and document current/future‑state architectures. Lead technical workstreams and proof‑of‑concept implementations, support critical platform issues and mentor less experienced engineers. Required Skills & Technology Microsoft Fabric: Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2 and Notebooks. Azure technologies including Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake and Azure Data Factory. Strong T‑SQL, Py Spark, Python and Spark SQL skills. Power BI, DAX, data modelling and semantic modelling. Direct Lake, Import/Direct Query and composite models. Delta Lake, SSIS, Power Query (M) and SQL Server. Azure Dev Ops or Git Hub Actions, Git‑based source control and CI/CD. Data platform security, access controls, governance, monitoring and backup/recovery concepts. Experience & Qualifications 5+ years' experience in data engineering, BI development or data warehousing, ideally in a client‑facing consulting environment. Hands‑on production experience delivering Microsoft Fabric solutions, including Lakehouse/Warehouse builds, pipelines and semantic modelling. Experience migrating legacy BI/ETL platforms to modern cloud architectures. Experience leading technical workstreams or small teams and mentoring junior engineers. Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science or a related field (NQF 6 or higher). Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate - required or in progress.

Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate - required or in progress. Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate - advantageous. Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals - minimum baseline where the above certifications are still in progress. Advantageous Experience Databricks and exposure to AWS or GCP. Machine learning workflows on Microsoft Fabric or data science tooling such as Python or R. SQL Server high‑availability and disaster‑recovery concepts. Agile/Scrum or Kanban delivery methods. Consulting or professional‑services experience managing multiple concurrent client engagements. Personal Attributes Strong client‑facing communication and stakeholder‑management skills. Confident running workshops and presenting technical or architecture decisions. Self‑motivated problem‑solver who takes ownership from design through production support. Structured and methodical, with strong technical documentation habits. Collaborative and comfortable mentoring less experienced team members. Able to manage multiple client engagements and changing priorities.

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior data professional who wants to combine hands‑on Microsoft Fabric engineering with architecture, client engagement and technical leadership. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Verantwoordelijke kinderopvang OKIDO Hoboken - Ferm Kinderopvang Antwerpen
description:

Het zijn kinderdagverblijven voor enerzijds dringende kinderopvang (minder dan een maand inschrijven voor de start van de opvang) en anderzijds reguliere opvang van kinderen tussen 0 en 3 jaar. We streven naar een mix van gezinnen.

Ouders kunnen er met hun kindjes terecht als ze gaan solliciteren of een tewerkstelling starten, een opleiding volgen of gezinsondersteunende opvang nodig hebben. Bij OKiDO werken gediplomeerde kinderbegeleiders samen met collega’s die tijdens de job de opleiding kinderzorg volgen.

Je bent de geknipte persoon want…

  • Je vormt een team met de collega-verantwoordelijke van Okido Hoboken (Oudestraat 55, 36 kindplaatsen).

  • Als team sta je in voor de verdere uitbouw van dit initiatief voor occasionele kinderopvang dat ook erkend is als lokale dienst buurtgerichte kinderopvang.

  • Dit impliceert de begeleiding en de coaching van de medewerkers, de contacten met de ouders, de opvolging van de kinderen, het pedagogisch beleid, netwerking en het globale (administratieve) beheer van het initiatief kinderopvang (waaronder het personeelscontingent).

  • Je onderhoudt de contacten met de opdrachtgever (OCMW Antwerpen).

Je overhaalt ons helemaal want…

  • Je bent in het bezit van een bachelor diploma.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met de sector (kinderopvang) en/of de doelgroep (intercultureel/kansarm/…).

  • Je hebt leidinggevende ervaring en bouwt op een professionele manier netwerken uit.

  • Je kan je behelpen in het Frans en het Engels.

Hiervoor zorgen wij…

  • Een deeltijds contract (24/40) van onbepaalde duur.

  • Een uitdagende job met ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen.

  • Je maakt deel uit van een grote groep Ferm, binnen een sterk groeiende zorgsector.

  • Naast een correct loonpakket mag je rekenen op een degelijke ondersteuning binnen de groep en op flexibele werkuren.

  • Ferm staat voor een gezond evenwicht tussen privé- en professioneel leven.

title: Lead AI Product Manager
description:
Insurance hasn’t changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.

Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.

At Zego, we’re leading the AI evolution in insurance.

We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes. Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers. Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.

Overview of the Product Team

Product Managers at Zego are change-makers. We build and scale data-driven, impactful solutions that enable Zego to offer competitive and personalised insurance. Working in a fast-paced Agile environment, our team thrives on innovation, cross-functional collaboration, and driving measurable outcomes.

We’re building a product organisation where AI isn’t a buzzword - it’s how we work. From rapid prototyping with generative AI to using machine learning models that power our core pricing, our PMs operate at the frontier of what technology can do for insurance.

From enhancing pricing models to streamlining digital experiences, our Product team is instrumental in shaping the future of insurance.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager who combines strategic depth with a hands-on builder’s instinct. You’ll own strategic workstreams that span multiple teams and business domains, defining the 6-12 month product direction and shaping how Zego’s products evolve to meet ambitious commercial targets.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership. You’ll define new product mechanics and revenue models. You’ll make build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations that shape Zego’s competitive position. And you’ll champion an experiment-first culture - using AI to compress discovery cycles, generate sharper insights, and ship at a velocity that sets the standard for the rest of the organisation.

You’ll work closely with Zego’s Leadership Team on strategic decisions, lead cross-functional programmes, and mentor Product Managers - raising the bar for how the entire product community operates.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Set the six-to-12-month product strategy across multiple teams and domains, including the build, buy or partner calls that shape Zego's competitive position.
  • Define and validate new revenue mechanics, from 0 to 1 propositions to upsell and retention loops, grounded in unit economics and customer insight rather than gut feel.
  • Embed rigorous experimentation as the default operating rhythm, so rate of learning replaces opinion as the leading metric.
  • Build reusable AI playbooks, workflows and assets that multiply the whole team's output, not just your own.
  • Design the product metrics and dashboards the business runs on, and use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground every strategic decision.
  • Own company-level programmes with direct P&L impact, accountable for commercial outcomes rather than feature delivery.
  • Coach Product Managers across the organisation, raising the bar for product craft and data capability.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Strategic product leadership. Significant experience leading product strategy across multiple teams or domains in a high-growth environment, with decisions that moved business-level metrics.
  • Experiment-first operator. You have built experiment cultures, not just run individual tests, and you make build, measure, learn the default rhythm for your teams.
  • Commercial and financial fluency. Deep understanding of unit economics, pricing levers and revenue modelling, and credible with Finance and Leadership on P&L-level decisions.
  • Data mastery. You design the metrics and dashboards the business relies on, and you are as comfortable in Snowflake as you are in a strategy review.
  • Technical depth. Comfortable engaging engineers on system architecture, APIs and ML pipelines, enough to make informed strategic bets.
  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

What it's like to work at Zego

At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.

Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.

This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

The Zego ways of working

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid some of us are in our central London office weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It is about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It is a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits

  • Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year
  • Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution
  • Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build
  • Private medical insurance, for you and your family
  • Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new
  • Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact

If you're ready to help build the real-time, data-driven infrastructure for an intelligent world, we want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join our team and help shape the future of contextual advertising as we continue to expand globally.



Por favor, verifique que tiene el nivel de experiencia y las cualificaciones adecuadas leyendo la descripción completa de esta oportunidad a continuación.
Who We Are

At Seedtag, our goal is to lead the change in the advertising industry because we believe that effective advertising should not be at odds with users’ privacy.


Every day, our teams develop new services that reach over 200 million users worldwide with fast response times to ensure that we deliver the best user experience. We’re fully committed to the DevOps culture, where we provide the platform that our Software Developers and Data Scientists use to manage over 100 different microservices, pushing dozens of changes to production every day. All of this is built on top of Kubernetes in Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services.


If you are interested in joining one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in Europe and working on massive scalability challenges, this is the place for you.


As a Full-Stack Engineer in the AdServing team, you’ll help shape two of Seedtag’s most critical tools:



  • Our SDK, the agent embedded in 200M+ devices daily, responsible for rendering ads in real time.
  • Studio Pro, the creative tool used by designers to build contextual ads across multiple formats and devices.

You’ll be working with modern, typed front-end languages (Rescript and React), building performant interfaces and reliable APIs, all while collaborating with design and backend teams to make sure everything just works.


We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving hard problems, cares about maintainable code, and is ready to make key architectural decisions as the product evolves.


Your day-to-day will include:



  • Designing and implementing client-side features for the SDK and Studio Pro.
  • Developing scalable backend APIs to support dynamic creative logic and data syncing.
  • Collaborating with designers, backend engineers, and product stakeholders to align on needs and priorities.
  • Working across the stack, from micro frontends to backend services.
  • Applying and advocating for clean code, testing, performance, and maintainability.
  • Taking ownership of key features and mentoring others as the team grows.

How do we work?



  • Do you know them too? We build high-throughput microservices, APIs, SDKs, dev tools…
  • Have you done that before? We practice DevOps, Peer Reviews, Continuous Discovery, Delivery and Integration.
  • You like that workflow? We collaborate on Slack, Notion, JIRA, Github.

Our core values

  • Outcome over output

Our core tech values reflect our commitment to delivering exceptional results, fostering a culture of continuous learning, and always putting the customer’s needs first. We believe that success comes from focusing on the outcomes rather than just the output. Our tech team aims to solve problems that make a meaningful difference, and we measure our success by the impact we have on the customer.



  • Failure is allowed, learning is a must

We also recognize that failure is an inevitable part of the innovation process. Our team understands that setbacks are opportunities to learn and grow. We believe in testing early and often, and we continuously iterate and improve until we arrive at the best solution.



  • We are all scouts

Another core value we hold is that we are all scouts. We believe in leaving things better than we found them. This means we take ownership of our work and strive to improve the systems and processes we touch. We encourage our team members to be proactive in identifying areas for improvement, and we value those who take the initiative to implement positive changes. Our goal is to leave a lasting, positive impact on our projects and our team.


Lastly, our team is data-driven. We believe that making informed decisions based on data is crucial to our success. Our team uses data to guide our decision-making process and to identify opportunities for improvement. We are committed to using data to continuously monitor and optimize our models and processes to ensure that we are delivering the best possible outcome for our customers.


We have to support 120k requests per second running with ML models in production answering within 10 milliseconds! We have this running in production with Python and GoLang microservices using datalakes, GCS, Redis, Kinesis or Kafka. All this is constantly deployed in GCP using Kubernetes and other kinds of production stacks. The current stack outputs 20 TB of daily data having them ready to use for analytics and more with easy and low latency access.


In the rest of the company, we also develop in Typescript for Nodejs and Scala making use of technologies like Kafka, Druid and MongoDB all over the Google Cloud Platform.


What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • You’re a full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience. You’re comfortable jumping between front-end and back-end, and you’ve built and maintained production-level apps using typed languages.
  • You’ve contributed to developer-facing tools, SDKs, or design systems, and enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of UX and code.
  • You write clean, maintainable code and know how to apply software engineering principles to keep things simple and robust.
  • You’re a strategic thinker, able to connect product needs with technical decisions and architecture.
  • You enjoy a good challenge and love finding elegant solutions to complex problems.
  • You’re always learning and staying up to date with new tech, frameworks, and practices.
  • You’re a strong communicator who thrives in collaborative environments.
  • You’re adaptable and used to working in fast-paced environments where priorities shift quickly.

Why Join Seedtag?

Growth & Opportunity: A key moment to join with vast career development prospects.


Flexibility: At Seedtag, we trust you to balance work and life effortlessly with the option to a 100% remote (Please note that while we operate as a 100% remote company, we can only extend contracts within Europe in countries where we have established legal entities: Spain, Italy, the UK, Belgium, the Netherlands, France, and Germany) or hybrid work setup, depending on what works best.


Learning & Development: Online courses and optional English or Spanish group classes.


Inclusive Culture: We foster a supportive environment that values personal growth.


Fun & Connection: Participate in team activities, company offsites, and more!



  • Gympass: Access to wellness programs and fitness classes.
  • Seedsave Program: Exclusive discounts to help you save for the future.
  • Build your home office with a gross budget of up to 1K€ (external screen, chair, table...)
  • Paid travels to our HQ in Madrid to work p2p with your squad members

Ready to join the Seedtag adventure?

Send us your CV and let’s grow together!


At Seedtag, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome diverse perspectives as they fuel our innovation and growth. xqbhyrx Please let us know if you require accommodations during the hiring process and we’ll ensure a positive and accessible experience.

title: Core Processor - Auto Salvage
description:
Location: Bevell's Pull-it-Yourself

1911 Hwy 117 South, Goldsboro, NC 27530


Monday - Friday 8am - 5pm



Position Overview

The core processor at a salvage yard is responsible for processing incoming cores by draining them of all fluids and removing any necessary parts. They use forklifts and chain hoists to move the cores and loaded boxes or crates, weighing them and packaging them for sale. The position also involves inventorying loaded boxes or crates, preparing them for shipping, and assisting with loading outgoing core products. The goal of the core processor is to efficiently and safely process the cores to maximize profits for the salvage yard.


Key Responsibilities and Essential Job Functions

  1. Production – Core Processing
  • Receiving incoming cores and identifying them for processing.
  • Removing all fluids from the cores and ensuring proper storage for disposal.
  • Preparing and packaging core products for shipment.
  • Removing parts from cores as necessary.
  • Assisting with loading outbound cores.
  • Operating forklifts and chain hoists to move the cores.
  • Packaging and inventorying the processed cores.
  • Use of drain tables and any necessary tools for removing parts from the cores
  • Processing of cores that meets or exceeds the amount of incoming product.
  • Timely processing of cores, and accurate documentation of inventory.
  • Effectively processing cores and preparing them for resale.

2. Quality Control

  • Quality control is an essential aspect of the core processing job.
  • Core processors need to follow strict guidelines to ensure that cores are drained of all fluids, parts are removed properly, and that the weight of the packages is accurate (when necessary).

3. Safety

  • Follow strict safety procedures for handling and processing cores.
  • Ensure that all cores are properly drained of fluids and hazardous materials, which is essential for maintaining a safe and environmentally-friendly workplace.
  • Ensure that all environmental and safety regulations are followed during the processing of cores.
  • Wearing proper personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Ensuring all equipment is properly inspected and following proper lifting and handling techniques to prevent injuries.
  • Reports any issues to their supervisor.

4. Perform Other Duties as Assigned

title: Amazon Image Brief & Conversion Associate
description:
Amazon images are where most listings win or lose. The main image decides whether anyone clicks. The six behind it decide whether they buy — and whether the parcel comes back.

We are hiring one person to own that. Take a live listing, work out from its reviews and returns why it is not converting, and write the image brief that fixes it — a brief a remote designer can execute without a single follow-up question.

This is an operational and analytical role, not a design role. You will not be making the artwork. You decide what it has to say, in what order, and you hold the returned files to that standard.

The split is 75 / 25.

• 75% — the briefs. The conversion thinking, the ranked USPs, the seven slots, the QA of what comes back.

• 25% — analysis and reporting. Part of it is the work that feeds the brief: pulling the reviews, reading them properly, turning them into a persona and a pain-point list. The rest is the follow-up reporting we owe clients — sales and traffic, return reasons, and what actually moved once new images went live.

You will work across markets. Mostly European and US listings, across many markets and languages, in categories you have never shopped in yourself.

What you will do

Image briefs and conversion thinking — 75% of the role

• Diagnose why a listing is not converting: what the gallery fails to answer, which objection nobody addressed, where the buyer loses confidence and leaves.

• Know what each slot is for. The main image earns the click. Images two to seven answer objections in the order a buyer actually raises them. The size and fit slots decide whether the sale stays sold.

• Rank seven USPs by what wins the click and what prevents a return. They are not the same list, and the order is the decision.

• Write the brief for each slot in our template: one message per slot, one headline, an optional subline, a maximum of three to four callouts, every line adding something new.

• Apply the two-second rule. One idea per image, legible at thumbnail size on a phone. If a slot needs a paragraph to work, it is not a slot.

• Work inside the client’s brand book — colours, fonts, existing assets — naming exactly which asset to reuse and where the file lives.

• Keep sizing accurate and internally consistent: backend size chart against image size chart, US against EU conventions.

• Know Amazon image policy cold: main-image rules, no price, ratings, review counts or badges, and how the gallery renders on a phone.

• QA the returned files against the brief and say precisely why something is not working — hierarchy, contrast, whitespace, text density, whether a close-up box earns its place.

The analysis behind the briefs — part of the 25%

• Download the reviews yourself and read them properly: themes, frequency, and the exact words customers use.

• Pull Voice of the Customer and the return report, and weight return reasons against units actually sold.

• Turn that into a buyer persona and a ranked pain-point list — for categories you did not grow up in.

• Separate “we can fix this on the listing” from “the product is the problem”.

• Evidence only. Never invent a return reason, a measurement or a number, and ask when something is missing.

Reporting that follows up sales — the rest of the 25%

• Find and download the right reports without being walked through it: Sales & Traffic, Search Query Performance, Returns, Voice of the Customer.

• Build the recurring follow-ups: sales and traffic trend, return rate by size, conversion before and after an image update.

• Merge two exports on ASIN or SKU and produce a clean pivot, without hand-counting rows.

• Deliver a one-page summary that says what matters, why it matters and what to do about it. Not a data dump.

Making the workflow better with AI — across all of the above

• Use Claude and ChatGPT as part of the work, not as a novelty: review analysis, first-draft copy, translation, summarising exports.

• Work inside our Claude projects, with the context and templates already there, and keep them current as the accounts change.

• Build repeatable workflows — project instructions, skills, prompt templates, SOPs — so the next product of a kind is faster than the last.

• Know where AI is unreliable and check it. Invented numbers, invented quotes and plausible-sounding measurements are the failure mode, and they are your responsibility, not the tool’s.

• Have an opinion about the tooling itself. We write our briefs in PowerPoint today and we are open to something faster — if you know a better way to brief a designer, we want to hear it and we will let you build it.

Requirements

Must-have:

• Two to three or more years working directly on Amazon listings — agency, brand or aggregator — with hands-on Seller Central or Vendor Central access.

• A real point of view on what makes an Amazon listing convert, and examples to back it. Image and A+ content strategy — not PPC only, not logistics only.

• Fluent in Amazon image policy and in how the gallery behaves on mobile.

• Experience improving a listing off the back of return-rate or review data. We will ask you to describe one.

• Solid Excel or Google Sheets: pivot tables, lookups, merging two exports on ASIN or SKU, and a per-size or per-ASIN breakdown from a raw Amazon report.

• You build with AI, you do not only prompt it: you have set up projects, custom instructions, reusable prompts or skills that someone other than you then used. Claude preferred, ChatGPT fine.

• Working knowledge of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or an equivalent.

• Experience with listings for a market that is not your own.

• Evidence-only discipline, and the judgement to ask rather than assume.

• Fluent written English to a professional standard, and the self-direction to run your own queue.

title: Senior Network Engineer: Private & Public Cloud
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Network Engineer to help us evolve our network landscape from a strong Virtual Private Cloud foundation towards combined private and public cloud environments, with a clear roadmap towards future hybrid solutions. In this role, you will design, implement, and operate network infrastructures that support our growing SaaS platforms, both on-premise and in Microsoft Azure.

Key About Your Team

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will join our Core-IT team of 22 professionals; currently responsible for a robust Virtual Private Cloud platform whilst actively expanding into Azure public cloud. The team operates across The Netherlands and India. Your primary base would be in Utrecht, working closely with 17 colleagues specializing in Networking, Virtualization, Backup, Security, Monitoring, and related disciplines.

Check out our blog posts and videos to see what it is like to work at Keylane.

Key About Your Role

You will support an IT infrastructure serving approximately 35 major clients in the pension and insurance sectors; impacting millions of users across Western Europe. Our platform consists of Dell and Cisco hardware, a fully virtualized VMware environment, and an emerging Azure landscape.

You will play a key role in building and shaping our Azure network foundations and preparing the organization for future hybrid connectivity. You will work at the intersection of architecture, engineering, and operations, contributing directly to the strategic evolution of our platform. Alongside this, the daily maintenance and operations of our existing Virtual Private Cloud. You will work with Cisco (ASA, ISR, Nexus, ACI), Nvidia (Mellanox), VMware, NSX, and Microsoft Azure networking services.

Key About Your Responsibilities

  • Transitioning from VMware NSX to Cisco ACI
  • Designing and implementing Azure network architectures (VNets, routing, security)
  • Laying the groundwork for future private–public cloud connectivity (VPN / ExpressRoute)
  • Selecting and positioning new network components (switches, firewalls)
  • Decommissioning legacy environments
  • Designing and improving a secure and hardened network architecture across private and public domains

Requirements

  • You are an experienced Network Engineer with expertise in datacenter and cloud networking
  • Security is a core part of your approach to network design and operations.
  • You have strong, hands-on experience with: OSPF, BGP, HSRP, vPC, IPsec VPN, SNAT/DNAT, and PBR.
  • You have experience designing and implementing Azure networking solutions (VNet design, routing, NSGs, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway and/or ExpressRoute).
  • You have a technical degree or equivalent experience

title: Library Internship - Cohort 2027
description:
ABOUT SALZBURG GLOBAL

Salzburg Global is where open-minded leaders from around the world gather for breakthrough conversations on pressing global issues.

Since 1947, our programs have worked to overcome barriers and open up a world of better possibilities – creating spaces where divergent voices can address the big challenges of our time.

We have gathered over 40,000 Fellows from 173 countries for more than 1,100 sessions that change the conversation on the pressing issues of our time.

That very first session brought together over 100 young Europeans and Americans – including veterans of the French resistance, survivors of Nazi concentration camps, prisoners of war, and former enemies.

They met at Schloss Leopoldskron, an Austrian palace that had been occupied by the Nazis in a country that was still under Allied military occupation. They wrestled with how diverse and fractured groups of people could come together and start creating the conditions for peace in the aftermath of World War II.

More than seventy-five years later, the challenges may be different, but our mission still carries that same founding spirit: to overcome barriers and open up a world of better possibilities.

We are supported by a combination of institutional partnerships, generous individual donations and revenue generated from our social enterprise, Schloss Leopoldskron.

We seek to be an exemplary international institution in terms of equity and environmental sustainability. We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply and join us in our work.

ABOUT OUR INTERNSHIPS

The internships are full-time, for a maximum period of three months.

Although the position is not paid, we will provide the successful candidate with:

  • board and lodging at Schloss Leopoldskron

  • a return ticket for their country of origin

  • excellent networking opportunities with the international participants of our programs

Start dates for the Library Internships are available in:

  • mid January

  • early July

  • late September

Should your application be successful, we will provide the exact dates on completion of the internship offer. Due to program scheduling and accommodation reasons, we do not accommodate internship requests outside these fixed periods.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As our point of contact for Salzburg Global’s small, private collection, your focus will be on archival work and library oversight. We will rely on you to create and curate our institutional archives and to maintain our private library. You will also be managing our periodicals collection.

In 2018, Salzburg Global moved its print documents to the Harvard University Archives. It is now seeking to systematize, organize and cull its digital documents. This unique opportunity will allow you to receive real-world experience transforming digital documents into a usable archive.

While in Salzburg, the intern will also have the opportunity to support one or more programs scheduled during the internship.

Typical duties include:

Archives:

  • Provide support for the filing system development (including the naming structure)

  • Review digital program-related documents and help curate our archives according to our Database policies

  • Identify important historical documents that may have been lost over Salzburg Global’s 75-year history

Library:

  • Catalog all new acquisitions and library holdings in DublinCore in our open-source, integrated library system, OpenBiblio, and the social cataloging platform LibraryThing

  • Assign call numbers in Dewey Decimal classification

  • Re-shelf and shift books that are out of place

  • Write gift plate and thank you notes

  • Maintain existing periodicals subscriptions and ensure their renewals as required

Program-related:

  • Researching relevant program topics, partners, and participants, including compiling biographies

  • Providing reliable administrative and operational support to the program teams (such as updating internal documents, printing program materials, copying, and mailing)

  • Providing event management and technical support in sessions (for instance: recording lectures, controlling the sound system, managing the microphones, presentation visuals management, etc.)

  • Note-taking during online meetings and programs

  • Providing database support

  • Providing participant support and facilitating positive group dynamics

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • You have recently completed or are in the process of completing your postgraduate studies in Library Information Science, or a related area, which should include at least one cataloging course

  • You have excellent communication skills in English, spoken and written, including editing skills

  • You are proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)

  • You are enthusiastic about our mission

  • You take initiative and embrace hands-on work

  • You are willing to work flexible hours according to the running program’s needs

  • You thrive in culturally and professionally diverse environments

Note: German language skills are not required.

Our Internship Program is specially designed for young professionals.

If you are under 18, sign up to our newsletter for upcoming internship opportunities and please wait for a couple of years before sending us your application.

If you are over 30 years old, please share the opportunity with your younger peers and consider applying for one of our programs instead.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees.

Sustainable business practices are our highest priority in all areas. We encourage creative, equitable, and sustainable change and develop environmentally conscious and socially responsible practices at all levels. We believe that every team member plays a critical role in our journey toward sustainability.

HOW TO APPLY

Only complete applications via the online form will be considered. A complete application will include a CV and a cover letter.

Selected applicants will be asked to complete an interview call.

All candidates, successful or otherwise, will be informed of the outcome of their application.

Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to take phone calls or to answer individual questions by email.

Should you successfully be selected, you will receive a very detailed information package in due time.

title: Senior Analyst - National Characterization
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Analyst - National Characterization based in United States.

This senior-level role provides leadership for the acquisition, stewardship, analysis, and reporting of material characterization data across multiple states.
You will establish national standards for data quality, consistency, comparability, and long-term usability across complex characterization programs.
The position combines advanced data analysis with governance, quality assurance, methodology development, and strategic program support.
You will shape national sort category frameworks and evaluate state and local studies for methodological alignment and integration opportunities.
Working closely with Data & Analytics and state teams, you will ensure characterization data supports reporting, benchmarking, strategic planning, and program evaluation.
The role requires strong technical judgment, advanced analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate complex findings into practical guidance for diverse stakeholders.
This is an opportunity to influence data standards and analytical practices across a growing, multi-state environmental and materials management program.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of processes for intake and integration of waste characterization datasets, including new studies, legacy data, third-party sources, and state-generated studies.
  • Oversee data quality assurance activities, including standardization, validation, preparation, metadata management, documentation, assumptions, and version control.
  • Establish and maintain national sort category frameworks and ensure consistent application across programs, state initiatives, and pilot studies.
  • Provide oversight of category mapping methodologies, resolving discrepancies and accommodating state-specific reporting requirements while maintaining analytical comparability.
  • Evaluate state and local waste characterization studies for methodological alignment, data suitability, quality, and opportunities for integration into broader characterization programs.
  • Lead analytical methodologies used to calculate key performance metrics such as contamination, capture, and recycling rates using validated characterization datasets.
  • Direct comparative and trend analyses to identify emerging patterns, support cross-state benchmarking, and inform programmatic decision-making.
  • Oversee analytical summaries, data visualizations, and reporting deliverables for internal stakeholders, strategic initiatives, and external reporting requirements.
  • Establish and maintain QA/QC frameworks, validation standards, and acceptance criteria that support the defensibility, consistency, and reliability of datasets.
  • Provide strategic guidance to state teams on data quality and reporting issues, promoting alignment with national standards and best practices.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics to ensure characterization data structures, classifications, and workflows align with enterprise data architecture and analytical requirements.
  • Develop and continuously improve SOPs covering data intake, QA/QC, category management, analytical methodologies, and long-term data governance.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree required; a Master’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Waste Management, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred.
    • 7–10 years of progressively responsible experience in waste characterization, recycling, materials management, environmental data analysis, or a related field, including leadership of complex data initiatives.
    • Advanced proficiency in Python and/or R for data management, transformation, statistical analysis, automation, and reproducible analytical workflows.
    • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated experience with data analysis, management, reporting, and large or complex datasets.
    • Strong knowledge of waste characterization methodologies, material classification systems, and performance metrics, including contamination, capture, and recycling rate calculations.
    • Proven experience designing or overseeing data governance, QA/QC, and quality management practices that ensure data integrity, consistency, and defensibility.
    • Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate data-driven insights through visualizations, dashboards, technical reports, and analytical summaries.
    • Strong technical writing capabilities, including experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, data standards, and analytical documentation.
    • Ability to translate complex methodologies, analytical findings, and data limitations into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Strong understanding of extended producer responsibility (EPR) programs and related policy, regulatory, and reporting frameworks.
    • Excellent project leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives and priorities in a dynamic environment.
    • Strong attention to detail, commitment to data accuracy, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
    • Ability to work independently, exercise sound professional judgment, identify risks, and proactively escalate issues when appropriate.
    • Strong collaborative skills and the ability to build productive relationships across departments, state teams, and external organizations.

      • Benefits:
